1º de Primaria · Inglés

Colours and numbers

Ficha para imprimir
123456
1

Pregunta de arranquePiensa 30 segundos antes de seguir

Look at the sky. What colour is it? Can you say it in English?

Escribe o di en voz alta tu respuesta. Después .

The sky is blue! And the sun is yellow. In this unit you will learn many colours and numbers.

2

Aprende12 apartados

Para empezar: The rainbow

It is raining. Mia and her grandpa look out of the window.

Then the sun comes out. «Look, Mia! A rainbow!»

Mia counts the colours: «One, two, three, four, five, six, seven! Seven colours!»

«What colours can you see?», asks Grandpa. «Red, orange, yellow, green, blue… and purple!»

«What's your favourite colour?» Mia smiles. «My favourite colour is green, like the grass.»

Grandpa laughs. «And mine is blue, like the sky!»

1. Red, blue and yellow

Let's learn three colours: red, blue and yellow.

A tomato is red. The sea is blue. A banana is yellow.

Point to something red in your classroom. Now point to something blue!

2. Green, orange and pink

Now three more colours: green, orange and pink.

The grass is green. An orange is orange. A pig is pink.

Orange is a fruit and a colour. Nice!

3. Purple, brown, black and white

More colours: purple, brown, black and white.

Grapes can be purple. Chocolate is brown.

The night is black. Snow is white. Now you know ten colours!

Vídeo: Learn Colors - Preschool Chant · ELF Kids Videos (YouTube) · 153,9 millones de visualizaciones

4. What colour is it?

To ask about colours, we say: What colour is it?

We answer: It's red. or It's green.

Play with a friend. Point to a pencil and ask. Your friend answers!

5. Mixing colours

Colours can mix. It's like magic!

Red and yellow make orange. Blue and yellow make green.

Red and blue make purple. Try it with paint!

6. My favourite colour

We all have a favourite colour.

Ask: What's your favourite colour?

Answer: My favourite colour is purple. What's your favourite colour?

Vídeo: What's Your Favorite Color? · Super Simple Songs (YouTube) · 196 millones de visualizaciones

7. Numbers one to five

Let's count: one, two, three, four, five.

Show your fingers. One hand has five fingers.

Say the numbers out loud. Clap your hands for each number: one (clap), two (clap)…

8. Numbers six to ten

Let's count more: six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

Two hands have ten fingers.

Count from one to ten. Then count back from ten to one, like a rocket: ten, nine, eight… zero! Blast off!

Vídeo: Counting 1-10 Song · The Singing Walrus (YouTube) · 93,4 millones de visualizaciones

9. How many?

To ask about numbers, we say: How many?

How many apples? Count them: one, two, three. Three apples!

With more than one, we add an s: one apple, two apples.

10. Colours and numbers together

We can use numbers and colours together.

Two red balloons. Four yellow stars. One green frog.

The number goes first. Then the colour. Then the thing. Easy!

11. Game: colour and count

Play Simon says with colours and numbers!

«Simon says: touch something blue!» «Simon says: jump three times!»

Listen carefully. If the teacher does not say «Simon says», don't move!

12. Review: I know colours and numbers

Now you know ten colours: red, blue, yellow, green, orange, pink, purple, brown, black and white.

You can count from one to ten.

You can ask What colour is it? and How many? Great job!

Lo hacemos juntos · Let's do it together

What colour is a banana?

  1. Think of a banana.
  2. It is like the sun.
  3. Say: It's…

Resultado: It's yellow.

How many fingers on one hand?

  1. Show one hand.
  2. Count: one, two, three, four, five.

Resultado: Five fingers.

Say: tres coches azules.

  1. Number first: three.
  2. Colour second: blue.
  3. Thing last, with s: cars.

Resultado: Three blue cars.

Blue and yellow make…

  1. Mix blue paint and yellow paint.
  2. Look at the new colour.

Resultado: Green!

Errores típicos

  • Saying «a car blue»: in English the colour goes first: «a blue car».
  • Forgetting the s: «two dog». We say «two dogs».
  • Mixing up «three» and «tree». Three is the number 3.
  • Saying «colour» like Spanish «color» with a strong r: the r is very soft.

PracticaResponde sin mirar arriba. Equivocarse aquí también enseña.

Ejercicios (22)

Hazlos en tu cuaderno y después abre la solución.

Nivel básico

  1. Point to something red.

    Ver solución
    For example, a red pencil.

  2. Say three colours in English.

    Ver solución
    For example, red, blue, yellow.

  3. Count from one to five.

    Ver solución
    One, two, three, four, five.

  4. What colour is the grass?

    Ver solución
    It's green.

  5. Colour a sun yellow.

    Ver solución
    A yellow sun.

  6. Show me six fingers.

    Ver solución
    One hand and one more finger.

  7. What number comes after two?

    Ver solución
    Three.

  8. Match: rojo – red, azul – blue.

    Ver solución
    Red = rojo; blue = azul.

Nivel medio

  1. Count from one to ten.

    Ver solución
    One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten.

  2. What colour is snow?

    Ver solución
    It's white.

  3. How many legs has a dog?

    Ver solución
    Four.

  4. Complete: Red and yellow make ____.

    Ver solución
    Orange.

  5. Answer: What's your favourite colour?

    Ver solución
    My favourite colour is… (free answer).

  6. Draw two blue fish.

    Ver solución
    Two fish coloured blue.

  7. Write the number: seven.

    Ver solución
    7.

  8. Write the word: 9.

    Ver solución
    Nine.

  9. Count back from ten to one.

    Ver solución
    Ten, nine, eight, seven, six, five, four, three, two, one.

Nivel avanzado

  1. Say the colours of the rainbow.

    Ver solución
    Red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple.

  2. Describe your pencil case: «I have three red pencils…».

    Ver solución
    Free answer, for example: I have two blue pencils.

  3. Ask five friends their favourite colour. Which colour wins?

    Ver solución
    Free answer: count the votes.

  4. Blue and red make ____. Yellow and blue make ____.

    Ver solución
    Purple; green.

  5. Make a colour book: one page for each colour with a drawing.

    Ver solución
    Free answer: ten pages, one colour each.

Explícalo con tus palabrasComo si se lo contaras a alguien de un curso menor

¿Has nombrado estas ideas?
★

Situación de aprendizajeOur class rainbow

We make a big rainbow for our classroom wall and count the things of each colour.

Pasos

  1. In groups, we choose one colour and say its name in English.
  2. We look for things of that colour in magazines and cut them out.
  3. We stick them on our strip of the rainbow.
  4. Each group presents: «Green. We have eight green things!».

Producto final: A big paper rainbow with pictures and numbers.

Cómo se valora

  • Names the colours in English.
  • Counts the pictures from one to ten.
  • Uses «We have… + number + colour».

Resumen visualTodo el tema en una pantalla

Glosario

Colour
Red, blue and green are colours (color).
Red
The colour of a tomato (rojo).
Blue
The colour of the sky (azul).
Yellow
The colour of a banana (amarillo).
Green
The colour of grass (verde).
Number
One, two and three are numbers (número).
Count
Say numbers in order: one, two, three (contar).
How many?
A question to ask for a number (¿cuántos?).
Favourite
The one you like best (favorito).
Rainbow
A bridge of colours in the sky (arcoíris).
6

Tarjetas de repasoToca la tarjeta para darle la vuelta

Según cómo respondas, la tarjeta vuelve mañana, en 3, en 7 o en 21 días.

Para familias

  • Jugad a «I spy with my little eye something… red» en casa o en el coche.
  • Contad en inglés al subir escaleras o al poner la mesa.
  • Al pintar, pedid los colores en inglés: «Blue, please».
  • Cantad la canción de los números del tema.

Para profesores

Saberes: Lengua extranjera (Inglés): léxico de colores y números del 1 al 10; estructuras What colour is it? It's…, How many…?; orden adjetivo-sustantivo y plural regular (RD 157/2022, primer ciclo de Educación Primaria).

  • Juego «Simon says» con colores y números.
  • Mezcla de pinturas para descubrir colores secundarios.
  • Bingo de números del 1 al 10.
  • Encuesta de colores favoritos con gráfico de barras sencillo.

Fuentes y revisión

  • Real Decreto 157/2022, enseñanzas mínimas de la Educación Primaria (BOE)

  • Count from one to ten
  • Ask and answer How many?
  • Say my favourite colour
